status: Canonical original reconstruction source fit, not an exact published angle. Numeric observations and raw query journals are retained separately. Distinct source accuracy and model residual are documented.
formula: Inside marked half-width h preserve z=a*lane. Outside use C1 integrated cubic smoothstep derivative from signed road-edge slope to measured signed outer slope. For u=abs(lane)-h, v=min(u,f), t=v/f: z=edge+d0*v+(d1-d0)*f*(t^3-.5*t^4)+d1*max(u-f,0). f=0 disables descriptor and retains previous plane/q path exactly.
convention: Outer slopes are dz/dsigned_lane; positive lane is driverRIGHT. Core half-width9m/2. Height fit is anchored to interpolated measured ground at the proposed shifted center, not an arbitrary vertical translation.
uncertainty: DGM absolute±0.15m; edge picks±0.5m each. Model residual is reconstruction error, separately reported, not claimed instrument accuracy.
